force_model.newtonian: Fully coupled Newtonian point-mass Sun/Earth/real Moon/second moon + seven other major planets

rotational_tides_and_spin.model: REBOUNDx tides_spin vector constant-time-lag equilibrium tide
rotational_tides_and_spin.implementation: one compiled C force plus one coupled vector-spin ODE
rotational_tides_and_spin.interaction_scope_explanation: Every configured structured source interacts with every other massive active particle; REBOUNDx exposes no source-target pair filter.

structured_bodies.name: earth
structured_bodies.provenance: k2 and inertia are standard bulk approximations; tau is resolved by the code from 38.2 mm/year lunar recession. This bounded CTL response is not a global ocean model.

permanent_figure.provenance: Carried for future reaction-aware attitude work; the current gravitational_harmonics J2 remains a separately labeled reaction-incomplete approximation.

structured_bodies.calibration_target: 38.2 mm/year circular real-Moon recession at 384,400 km

structured_bodies.name: real_moon
structured_bodies.provenance: k2 is representative of lunar laser ranging; tau is an order-of-magnitude CTL translation of lunar dissipation, not a frequency-independent material measurement. The 4.139-day spin is a counterfactual synchronous initial state.

permanent_figure.provenance: Representative unnormalized lunar gravity coefficients, carried only for a future reaction-aware quaternion backend.

structured_bodies.name: second_moon
structured_bodies.provenance: Explicit intermediate rocky-body sensitivity assumption. The giant moon has no measured Love number, lag, inertia, or spin.

permanent_figure.provenance: Zero permanent figure is the only defensible nominal value without an interior model or measurement.

rotational_tides_and_spin.force_and_torque_contract: Each CTL channel applies equal-and-opposite orbital force and the balancing torque to the deformed body's spin.
rotational_tides_and_spin.conservative_limit: k2=0 or tau=0 removes that body's dissipative CTL contribution
omissions: frequency-dependent ocean, mantle, and solid-body response
time-varying Earth inertia and atmosphere/ocean angular momentum
permanent J2/C22 figures with reaction-aware attitude dynamics

first_post_newtonian.scope: full first-order post-Newtonian interactions among all active bodies

earth_j2_and_first_post_newtonian.energy_diagnostic: Use the REBOUNDx gr_full Hamiltonian plus the gravitational-harmonics potential for conservative-only audits; the separately attached tide is dissipative.
remaining_omissions: Earth J2 source-spin reaction torque, free nutation, and polar motion
post-1PN relativity, solar frame dragging, and solar quadrupole

rotational_conservation_diagnostic.interpretation: Orbital plus configured spin angular momentum. Strictly conserved for isolated reaction-complete limits; with Earth gravitational_harmonics enabled, its omitted source-spin reaction makes this a bounded diagnostic rather than a conservation claim. Positive-lag CTL tides dissipate the reported mechanical energy.

newtonian_energy_diagnostic.interpretation: Not a total conserved-energy error: the diagnostic omits J2/1PN Hamiltonian terms and the tide is dissipative.

four_body_frame.ephemeris_states: DE440 BCRS/ICRF Cartesian states at the epoch

comparison_to_previous_earth_only_10y_au.scope: current three-structured-body nominal CTL scenario minus the tracked Earth-only CTL enhanced audit

validation_scope.endpoint_status: production result; not independently converged over the full ten-year horizon
validation_scope.strongest_full_horizon_check: The separately tracked one-year audit includes 365-day IAS15 tolerance and output-cadence comparisons.

interpretation: Positive-lag CTL tides are dissipative; mechanical energy should decrease.
Production angular momentum is a bounded diagnostic because Earth J2 lacks its source-spin reaction.
Strict isolated J2-off conservation is covered by test_rotational_conservation.py.
Giant-moon Love number, time lag, inertia, spin, J2, and C22 are sensitivity assumptions.
Permanent figures and physical libration remain disabled pending a reaction-aware attitude backend.
